name: Grilled Chicken Caprese

instructions.primary_message: Place 1 chicken breast half in a resealable plastic bag or between two pieces of plastic wrap. Using a meat pounder, rolling pin, or small skillet, pound chicken breast into an even thickness, about 2-cm thick. Repeat process with remaining 3 breasts.

Set a wire rack over a large rimmed baking sheet, and arrange chicken breasts on it. Sprinkle chicken all over with 2 teaspoons kosher salt; refrigerate, uncovered, for at least 30 minutes or up to 12 hours.

For a Charcoal Grill: Open bottom vent completely. Light large chimney starter filled with charcoal briquettes (6 quarts). When top coals are partially covered with ash, pour evenly over half of grill. Set cooking grate in place, cover, and open lid vent completely. Heat grill until hot, about 5 minutes.
For a Gas Grill: Turn all burners to high, cover, and heat grill until hot, about 15 minutes. Leave all burners on high.

Season chicken all over with 1 teaspoon pepper, and brush lightly with 1 tablespoon oil. Clean and oil cooking grates. Place chicken on grill and cook (over coals if using charcoal or covered if using gas) until chicken develops dark grill marks, 3 to 5 minutes. Flip, and continue to cook until chicken registers 155℉ (68℃), 3 to 5 minutes longer. Remove chicken from grill, let rest 5 minutes.

While chicken rests, brush tomato slices evenly with 1 tablespoon oil and sprinkle with remaining 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Brush sliced bread evenly with remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Grill tomatoes and bread (over coals if using charcoal), uncovered, until tomatoes are lightly charred but still juicy and holding their shape and bread is toasted, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a platter, and rub toasted bread all over with garlic. Set bread aside until ready to serve.

Divide and arrange grilled tomatoes evenly over chicken; top evenly with sliced mozzarella. Carefully transfer topped chicken to grill (on cooler side, if using a charcoal grill) and cook, covered, until mozzarella is warmed through and beginning to melt, 2 to 4 minutes.
Transfer chicken to serving platter or individual plates. Drizzle evenly with balsamic glaze and garnish with basil leaves. Serve immediately with toasted bread.

schema_metadata.keywords: grilled chicken breasts, Grilled Chicken Caprese

description: For this easy grilled chicken Caprese, juicy chicken breasts are topped with charred summer tomatoes, creamy mozzarella, fresh basil, and balsamic glaze.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 20 min.

Optional or for serving: Torn fresh basil leaves, for serving

Optional substitutions: balsamic glaze syrup → syrup

Make-ahead and storage: Leftover chicken can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Leah Colins
